headline: Seoul’s market ambitions meet a hard sell-off, as profit-taking hits the KOSPI
summary: Foreign investors kept selling into a volatile KOSPI, following a record monthly net outflow. Another heavy daily sell-off added fresh downward pressure on the index.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, heavily weighted toward large chipmakers and industrial groups. Foreign flows strongly influence its direction.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Heavy foreign selling and a daily sell-off added downward pressure on the index.
